**Which file**, from [ATTRIBUTION.md](../../ATTRIBUTION.md).

**Anything that shows it is yours** — a link to where you posted it, or just say
so. This is taken at face value; nothing has to be proved.

It will be removed. Sprites are read by path, so it is a one-line change to
`src/roster.mjs` and a deleted file — no argument, no delay.
